ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the circle $\odot O$ with radius $r=10$, and a chord $AB=16$, $P$ is a moving point on chord $AB$. What is the minimum length of segment $OP$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw $OH \perp AB$ at point H, and connect OB.\\
Therefore, $AH=BH=\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{1}{2}\times 16=8$,\\
In $\triangle BOH$, $OH=\sqrt{OB^{2}-BH^{2}}=\sqrt{10^{2}-8^{2}}=\boxed{6}$.
